content.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
content.subheading: Quick answers to common questions about our services and support

items.question: How do I request a new project or service?
items.answer: You can submit a request through our Contact page or call us directly at +92 315 8399446. Our team will review your requirements and provide a detailed proposal within 24-48 hours.

items.question: What are your support hours?
items.answer: Our technical support team is available Monday through Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (PKT / GST). For urgent issues, we offer 24/7 emergency support via phone and WhatsApp.

items.question: How quickly will I receive a response to my inquiry?
items.answer: We aim to respond to all inquiries within 2-4 business hours. Critical support tickets are prioritized and typically addressed within 1 hour during business hours.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing maintenance and support packages?
items.answer: Yes, we offer flexible maintenance packages including basic, standard, and premium tiers. Each plan includes different levels of response time, monitoring, and dedicated support resources.

items.question: Can I track the status of my support request?
items.answer: Absolutely. Once your ticket is submitted, you will receive a unique tracking ID. You can use this ID to check the status of your request or follow up with our support team.

Frequently Asked Questions About Our IT Solutions

items.question: What IT services does your company provide?
items.answer: We offer a wide range of IT solutions including software development, web development and mobile application, cloud computing, cybersecurity, IT consulting, system integration, and ongoing technical support tailored to your business needs.

items.question: How do you ensure the security of our data and systems?
items.answer: We implement industry-standard security protocols including end-to-end encryption, multi-factor authentication, regular security audits, and compliance with international data protection regulations to keep your systems and data safe.

items.question: Do you provide customized IT solutions for businesses?
items.answer: Absolutely. Every solution we build is tailored to your specific business requirements, industry, and goals. We work closely with your team to understand your workflows and deliver technology that fits perfectly.

items.question: What kind of support do you offer after project completion?
items.answer: We provide comprehensive post-launch support including 24/7 monitoring, bug fixes, performance optimization, software updates, and a dedicated help desk to ensure your systems run smoothly at all times.
